title: The Power of Keys
text: Keys are principles and laws established by the creator of a product necessary for successful function. That's a key. When you buy a lock, the key comes with with the with the lock, doesn't it? Right? Then you never buy a lock without a key. Because whatever you lock up, you want to be able to open it. So, the key is the product's functioning. It gives you the power to function. When you buy a car, I hope you I hope they give you a key with it. Why? This car got power, got all this awesome engine, but you need that key to have it function. So, keys are simply the most powerful instrument cuz they allow the product to function. God says, "I give you the whole world. I give you dominion. I give you all this wonderful, powerful Earth." He said, "But I'm going to give you the keys by which it functions, and they come from heaven." He says, "The kingdom of heaven, the keys of the kingdom of heaven." They didn't come from your education. This is why we got to study the word of God, why we have to learn God's keys, at least enough of them so we can wake up every Monday know what to do. Know what to turn, know what to fix, because we need to be able to put our hands into life and say, "I know what to do to make that thing happen."
